subject: AWS Marketplace: Visual assets, trust evidence & launch readiness
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Sam Thomas <sam.thomas@acmecloud.com>, procurement@acmecloud.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Apr 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace: Visual assets, trust evidence & launch readiness

Hi Sam / Acme procurement team —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we're preparing the AWS Marketplace offer page for Redwood Inference and want to get a short alignment on visuals, trust evidence, and any procurement asks before we upload the assets. Attaching an initial pack (visuals_v1.zip) and a draft evidence binder (evidence_binder_draft.pdf) for your review.

Top asks from our side:
- Can you confirm the buyer-facing hero image size and one example customer logo placement that you prefer?
- Any mandatory procurement footnotes (billing entity, PO flow) we should surface on the page?
- Please highlight any compliance evidence gaps that will block listing (e.g., SOC2 docs, data locality attestation).

Timeline: our tentative upload window is next Wednesday, 16 Apr. If we need more time we'll shift to the following Monday but would like to lock assets by EOD Tue 15 Apr.

Attachments: visuals_v1.zip (hero + 3 tile options), evidence_binder_draft.pdf (SOC2 summary, data-retention statement, support SLA).

Thanks — Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Field GTM, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Thomas <sam.thomas@acmecloud.com>, procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Sat, 12 Apr 2025 13:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace: Visual assets, trust evidence & launch readiness

Markus / team — quick pass from product/ops after skimming the attachments. Inline notes:

- Hero: the first hero (hero_a.png in visuals_v1.zip) is clean but we should remove the copy block overlay — AWS thumbnails crop aggressively on mobile. Recommend supplying a second variant with copy baked into the image and a plain background.
- Tiles: tile_b has small text that will become illegible on the marketplace tile; increase type size or swap to icon-only callouts.
- Evidence binder: good start. Missing explicit link to our SOC2 Type II cert (PDF) — that's required for many procurement teams. I can pull the PDF if legal approves.
- AMI/AMI tag note: confirm whether Acme requires AMI to be published in us-east-1 only or multi-region. That affects our AMI tag and entitlement footnote.

Action items for our side: 1) Produce hero_alt.png (copy baked) 2) Export tile variants with larger type 3) Get SOC2 cert PDF from Legal (if approved I will attach).

I'll start the image exports early Monday. Kim / Marissa, can you confirm the landing CTA copy? My proposed shortline: "Start a free trial — deploy in minutes."

-Aditya
From: Sam Thomas <sam.thomas@acmecloud.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Apr 2025 07:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace: Visual assets, trust evidence & launch readiness

Thanks Markus — saw the attachments and the notes. A few clarifying Qs from procurement and our marketplace ops team (see attached acme_procurement_questions.docx):

- Billing & PO: Our procurement wants the billing entity line to read "Redwood Inference, Inc. (US)" and to list a standard PO exception clause for software subscriptions. Can you confirm?
- License / AMI: We prefer AMI in us-east-1 for initial listing. Is the Redwood AMI region-tagged or do you publish per-region?
- Evidence: we need the SOC2 Type II PDF and a statement of data residency (US only) to be included in the evidence binder.
- DocuSign: we'd like to pre-seed a standard MSA via DocuSign if possible. Send link and we'll route internally.

We're aiming for a soft-launch next week but procurement may require up to 5 business days to review the documents. To keep momentum, can you upload the assets to a shared Drive and share a DocuSign draft? We'll circulate internally and get back with any redlines by Thu 17 Apr.

Best,
Sam Thomas
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Acme Cloud
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Sam Thomas <sam.thomas@acmecloud.com>, procurement@acmecloud.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Apr 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace: Visual assets, trust evidence & launch readiness

Sam / Acme procurement — appreciate the clear asks. Quick update and commitment items so the timeline is explicit: 

1) Billing entity: confirmed — we'll surface "Redwood Inference, Inc. (US)" on the offer and include the standard PO exception clause. Rachel will confirm the exact legal wording by EOD Mon 14 Apr.
2) AMI region: we'll publish the AMI in us-east-1 for initial listing and mark multi-region availability as "coming soon". Aditya — please confirm AMI build/export by EOD Mon.
3) SOC2 & data residency: Marissa will request the SOC2 Type II PDF from Legal; expect delivery Tue 15 Apr. We'll add a one-paragraph data residency statement to the binder (US only).
4) DocuSign: creating a pre-seeded MSA draft now and will push a DocuSign link to this thread when ready (target: Mon 14 Apr).

Uploads & links: I uploaded the current assets to the Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleDriveLink — please comment in the Drive for any visual tweaks.

Next steps / owners:
- Aditya: hero_alt.png + tile exports; confirm AMI export timing.
- Marissa: SOC2 request + evidence binder edit.
- Rachel: billing entity legal line & procurement footnote.
- Kim: sign-off on final CTA copy & marketplace description.

If procurement needs more time, we'll shift the upload window by a few days — but let's try to keep the soft-launch target. Thanks all.

-Markus
